## Where in the build you got stuck

Which phase of [PROJECT.md](../../PROJECT.md) were you on? (e.g., "Phase 0 — smoke testing the PDB skill" or "Phase 1 — first chapter")

## Your setup

- Antigravity 2.0 version (`agy --version`):
- OS / architecture (e.g., macOS arm64, Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, Raspberry Pi 5 aarch64):
- `uv --version`:
- Science Skills plugin installed at `~/.gemini/config/plugins/science/`? (yes/no)
- Stitch MCP registered in Antigravity? (yes/no)

## What you ran and what happened

Paste the command (or describe the Antigravity prompt), then what the IDE / CLI showed back. Trim it down — the first ~30 lines of an error are usually enough.

## What you expected

One sentence.

## Anything else

Logs, screenshots, links to your own fork, the time of day — anything that helps reproduce.
